Certain courses may only be offered once per year depending on availability. CDIS 100 can be taken prior to or concurrently with CDIS 204. CDIS 100 is a prerequisite for CDIS 205 and CDIS 206. You will need at least a 2.0 (C) in CDIS 204 and a 2.0 in a statistics course to progress with the major


The following are the LOWER DIVISION REQUIREMENTS for this major.

Please visit the catalog for all requirements for Communication Sciences and Disorders, B.A.


Any college-level Statistics course may be substituted for MATH111 outlined in the lower division core requirements below.


Students planning to go to graduate school will need 1 course in each of the following 4 areas:

  • Statistics
  • Biology
  • Social Science
  • Chemistry or Physics
